name: Start-up visa

requirements.blocker_text: This route closed to new applicants on 13 April 2023 and has been replaced by the Innovator Founder visa. No new applications are possible under any circumstances.

sources.title: Start-up visa (closed to new applicants) - GOV.UK

notes: SCHEMA GAP FIXED (2026-08-08): first real use of the new 'closed' status value, superseded_by, and closed_date fields — this route was deliberately excluded from the dataset entirely when UK was first completed, on the grounds that the schema had no way to represent 'closed' honestly. Per schema-v1.md's own open-decisions list ('Closed routes — keep visible with status: closed? Argument for: nobody else archives, and people search for routes that no longer exist'), that argument wins: someone researching UK options may well search for 'Start-up visa' having seen it referenced elsewhere, and finding nothing is worse than finding a clearly-marked closed route pointing to its actual successor. Existing holders of Start-up visas already granted are unaffected by the closure and can still extend/settle under transitional rules not encoded here, since this file represents the closed NEW-APPLICATION path only.
